title: Figure 9. Schematic of the Virtual Cowl Concept (scramjet inlet)
description: Line schematic of a vehicle forebody and inlet with an incoming "Flow" arrow and blue "Deflected streamlines" bending around an orange ellipse labeled "Heated region" located upstream of the "Cowl lip." Captioned "Figure 9. Schematic of the Virtual Cowl Concept. Plasma-generated heated region upstream of the cowl lip deflects the flow and scoops more air into the inlet." Text below begins the section "MHD Applications to Reentry and Near-Orbital Flight."
